# Versions for the CI mirroring (mirror-dryrun.yml, and docs/ci/mirror.yml),
# so that its mirrors are byte-for-byte what the cron on drogon makes.
#
# dandiset.yaml is written by dandi's yaml_dump() (ruamel.yaml, typ="safe",
# default width), and where ruamel.yaml breaks long lines depends on its
# version and on whether its C emitter (ruamel.yaml.clib) is used.  What drogon
# writes today (checked on 001697, 2026-11) is reproduced exactly by the
# pure-Python emitter of ruamel.yaml 0.17.40 to 0.18.12; 0.18.13+ (and 0.19)
# break lines elsewhere, and the C emitter does not wrap e.g. a long
# '@context' URL.  Hence 0.18.12 here, and the workflows uninstall
# ruamel.yaml.clib (a constraint cannot exclude a package).  Lift these
# together with drogon's environment.
ruamel.yaml == 0.18.12
dandi == 0.82.0
